operatorApproval.approvedBy: operator (blanket instruction 2026-11-04: continue automatically; no per-task review) -- this unit is post-merge follow-up on a defect the series' own gate under-reported
operatorApproval.notes:
Found after #616 merged, by running AUDIT/integrity-scan.mjs in a second checkout of the same tree. The scan read a directory listing to pick each unit's canonical generation, so empty leftover control directories -- which git cannot store -- changed the answer: offenders=2 beside the trail against offenders=3 on main, for byte-identical committed bytes. The truth is three canonical chain offenders (E02->E03, FIX-2->FIX-3, T09->T10), each a child unit that never emitted a record; the series has been reporting two in PLAN-COMPLETION.json. The fix makes canonical mean the highest-ranked generation that actually holds a record and makes named negative-control generations (out-negctl*, out-noparent*, out-tampered*) never canonical even when populated. No runtime code and no test changed; the suite is not re-run for this unit.

X15: X14 was emitted terminal and the trail continued past it; this generation names X15 at the task commit the scanner fix landed (2eee4d1a), so the chain does not stop at a record whose series kept going. Same shape as X13/out-chain. Only nextTaskId/nextBaseSha, the added evidence references and the note change; every other byte is X14/out's.
